content.en:
Use **map A**; put its printed size-3 enclosure empty-side up. Put **Animals** at strength 1 and randomize the other four level-I action cards into 2-5. Every player takes 25 money, 1 active worker, 3 inactive workers, 7 map-edge markers, 2 secret end-game cards, and keeps 4 of 8 zoo cards. Set up the break marker, 6-card display, association supply, projects, and bonus tiles as shown for the player count.

![Official V2.0 setup reference](/images/rules/ark-nova/official-setup.jpg)
content.zh:
使用 **A 地图**，将其印刷的 3 格兽栏以空面朝上放好。**动物**置于强度 1，其余 4 张 I 级行动卡随机置于 2–5。每人拿 25 金钱、1 名可用工作者、3 名未启用工作者、地图左侧 7 枚圆片、2 张秘密终局卡，并从 8 张动物园卡中留 4 张。按人数准备休息标记、6 张公开牌、协会供应、项目和奖励板块。

![官方 V2.0 准备参考](/images/rules/ark-nova/official-setup.jpg)

title.zh: 你的回合：选择一项行动

content.en: **Choose 1 action card -> set its strength -> resolve it -> move it to 1.** Its position is strength 1-5. Before resolving, spend any number of X-tokens for +1 strength each. Shift every card left of the used card right, then put the used card at 1. Resolve an **after your action** effect only after that shift. If no other action is useful, take 1 X-token instead (only while below 5), then shift normally.
content.zh: **选 1 张行动卡 -> 确定强度 -> 结算 -> 放回 1。** 卡位决定 1–5 强度；行动开始前可花任意 X 标记，每枚 +1 强度。将所选卡左边的卡都右移，再把它放到 1。“行动后”效果要等移动完行动卡才执行。若没有其他可做或想做的行动，可改拿 1 枚 X 标记（未满 5 枚时），仍要照常移动行动卡。

alt.en: Use a strong action, shift cards, and return it to 1
alt.zh: 使用高强度行动后移动卡牌，并把它放回 1

title.en: Cards: Move Break 2, Then Take Cards

content.en:
First move the break marker **2** spaces, with no money. Level I either draws by its table or, at the required strength, **snaps** one card from anywhere in the display; snapping replaces drawing. Level II may mix deck draws with cards in Reputation range (your register and lower registers). Refill the display only after your entire turn: slide first, then refill. Only level-II Cards permits Reputation 10+.

![Official V2.0 display reference](/images/rules/ark-nova/official-cards-display.jpg)
content.zh:
先将休息标记前移 **2 格**，不获得金钱。I 级按表格抽牌，或在所需强度下从公开列任意位置**抢** 1 张；抢牌替代抽牌。II 级可把牌库抽牌与声望范围（所在档案格及更低编号格）内的牌混合拿取。整回合结束后才补公开列：先下滑，再补满。只有 II 级抽卡能把声望升到 10 以上。

![官方 V2.0 公开列参考](/images/rules/ark-nova/official-cards-display.jpg)

content.en:
Pay **2 money per space** before each building. It must cover empty build spaces, stay on the map, and share an edge with an existing building; only your first building may touch a map edge instead. Rock and water never build. Keep at least two spaces between kiosks and take covered bonuses immediately. Level I builds one eligible building up to its strength. Level II builds different buildings with total size up to strength, unlocks restricted spaces, and adds the reptile house and large bird aviary.

![Official V2.0 building examples](/images/rules/ark-nova/official-build-examples.jpg)
content.zh:
每个建筑放置前支付**每格 2 金钱**。建筑要覆盖空建造格、不越界，并与已有建筑共边；只有首个建筑可改为接触地图边缘。岩石和水域不能建。两座售票亭之间至少隔 2 格；覆盖奖励立即获得。I 级建造 1 个大小不超过强度的合格建筑；II 级可建多个不同建筑、总大小不超过强度，并解锁受限格、爬虫馆和大型鸟舍。

![官方 V2.0 建造例子](/images/rules/ark-nova/official-build-examples.jpg)

alt.en: A matching empty enclosure is required before an animal
alt.zh: 安置动物前必须有匹配的空兽栏

content.en: For each animal allowed by the table: meet every prerequisite, pay its cost, and occupy a legal empty enclosure. A matching partner zoo cuts **3 money per continent icon** on that animal. Standard enclosures hold one animal; petting animals require the petting zoo, while reptiles and some birds can use their special enclosure. Gain Appeal and resolve immediate effects one animal at a time. **After** effects wait until every animal and the action-card shift are complete.
content.zh: 对表格允许的每只动物依次做：满足全部前提、付费用、占用合法的空兽栏。对应大陆的合作动物园会让该动物卡上的每个大陆图标减 **3 金钱**。普通兽栏只容纳 1 只；亲子动物须进亲子动物园，爬虫和部分鸟类可进特殊兽栏。每只动物依次获得吸引力、结算即时效果；“行动后”效果等所有动物和行动卡移动完成再做。

content.en: Assign active workers to work whose required strengths total no more than your action. Before the upgrade, do exactly one work; after it, do several **different** works. Your own worker on a repeated work makes it cost two workers; other players never block you. Take Reputation, a partner zoo, a university, or support a project. For a project, put a left-edge map marker on one requirement you meet and take its reward. After upgrading, one donation is allowed if you performed at least one work.
content.zh: 派可用工作者做印刷强度总和不超过本次行动的工作。协会未升级时只做 1 项；升级后可做多项**不同**工作。同一项工作已有你自己的工作者时，再做要 2 名工作者；其他玩家不会阻挡你。可提升声望、拿合作动物园、拿大学或支持项目。支持项目时，把地图左侧 1 枚圆片放在一个你满足的条件上，获得该奖励。协会升级后，若至少做了 1 项工作，可额外捐款 1 次。

alt.en: A worker supports a conservation-project requirement
alt.zh: 工作者支持一个保育项目条件

title.en: Sponsors: Play Cards or Take Money

content.en: Level I plays exactly one sponsor from hand when strength meets its level and conditions, **or** moves the break marker by strength and takes that much money. Level II plays sponsors one at a time with total levels at most **strength + 1**, and may play in-range display sponsors for their register number in extra money. The money alternative becomes twice the strength. Refill the display after the full turn.
content.zh: I 级在强度达到卡牌等级、并满足条件时，从手牌打出恰好 1 张赞助商，**或**将休息标记前移等同强度的格数并拿等额金钱。II 级可依次打多张赞助商，等级总和不超过**强度 + 1**，也可从声望范围公开列打出并额外支付该格编号的金钱。拿钱时改为强度的两倍；整回合结束后补公开列。

content.en: Reputation sets your display range; take any track reward immediately. At 15, each further Reputation becomes 1 Appeal. The usual upgrade opportunities are the Conservation track, Reputation track, second partner zoo, and second university. Project requirements count top-of-card icons on your played animals/sponsors plus partner zoos and universities; card prerequisites do **not** count as owned icons. Every supported project removes one map-edge marker and activates that bonus.
content.zh: 声望决定公开列范围，进入轨道奖励格时立即获得。声望到 15 后，每个无法再推进的声望改为 1 吸引力。常见升级机会来自保育轨道、声望轨道、第 2 个合作动物园和第 2 所大学。项目条件计算已打出动物 / 赞助商卡顶端图标、合作动物园与大学；卡牌左侧前提**不**算拥有图标。每支持一次项目都移走地图左侧 1 枚圆片并激活该奖励。

content.en: When the marker reaches the end, finish the turn, take 1 X-token, and lose excess movement. Then: **1** discard to 3 cards (or 5 with the university); **2** return poison/constrict markers from action cards; **3** return workers and refill association supply; **4** discard registers 1 and 2, slide and refill display; **5** take Appeal income, kiosk income, then purple break income; **6** reset the marker. The player clockwise after the triggerer acts next.
content.zh: 标记到终点后，完成当前回合，拿 1 枚 X 标记，多余移动作废。然后依次：**1** 弃到 3 张（有对应大学则 5 张）；**2** 归还行动卡上的毒 / 缠绕标记；**3** 工作者回来并补协会供应；**4** 弃档案格 1、2，牌下滑后补满；**5** 拿吸引力收入、售票亭收入、紫色休息收入；**6** 重置休息标记。触发者顺时针下一位开始行动。

content.en:
Game end triggers when Appeal and Conservation occupy the same score band or cross. At turn end, every **other** player gets one final turn; during a break, **everyone** gets one. Resolve end-game cards and played end-game effects. Score **Appeal + the small white value beside your Conservation space**. At 10 Conservation, everyone keeps one of two end-game cards; otherwise choose before scoring. Ties: more supported projects, then share victory.

![Official V2.0 end-game reference](/images/rules/ark-nova/official-end-scoring.jpg)
content.zh:
吸引力与保育进入同一计分区或交错，即触发终局。回合结束触发时，除触发者外每人各 1 个最后回合；休息中触发时，**所有人**各 1 个。结算终局卡与已打出卡的终局效果。最终分 = **吸引力 + 保育格旁的小白数字**。任一人到 10 保育时，所有人从 2 张终局卡中留 1 张；否则计分前再选。平手看支持项目数量，仍平手共同获胜。

![官方 V2.0 终局参考](/images/rules/ark-nova/official-end-scoring.jpg)

content.en: Use solo tiles instead of the break marker. Start at 20 Appeal (10 or 0 for harder games), move one solo marker after every turn, and take a break when the final left-column marker moves. After six rounds, score normally: **100+** wins. Use blue solo effects instead of interactive animal effects where printed.
content.zh: 用单人板块代替休息标记。以 20 吸引力开始（更难可用 10 或 0）；每回合后移动 1 枚单人圆片，左列最后一枚移走时休息。共六轮后正常计分，**100 分以上**获胜。卡牌印有蓝色单人效果时，用它替代互动动物效果。
